$comment: Provenance of the vendored canonical contract and its normative test vectors.
vizra-search never edits these files; vizra-core owns them. The contract-drift
lane verifies BOTH digests, so an in-place edit here fails CI by design.
If the contract is wrong it is changed in vizra-core and re-vendored here.
authority: ADR-002 (Accepted 2026-09-20) and the Q-001 ruling: the internal contract is written in core's canonical OpenAPI and drift-checked in both repos. The vectors file declares itself normative for both repositories.

files.role: normative HMAC conformance vectors: `vectors` are ACCEPT cases, `negative_vectors` are REJECT cases, and an implementation MUST consume both halves
